title: Kick The Punt And The Drop (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the kick is a tactical weapon
Punt for distance, drop for points
Grubber for the chase, son, three styles to learn

[Verse 1]
Punt kick, hold the ball with two hands
Laces facing the target, tip down stands
Drop the ball onto the laces of the boot
Strike through the middle, follow through suit

[Pre-Chorus]
Non kicking foot plants beside the ball spot
Kicking leg swings through, lock the knee taught
Aim for the ball to spin end over end
Spiral kick for distance, mortar bend

[Chorus]
Kick the punt and the drop, son
Foot connects with the laces, the work begun
Spiral for distance, end over end for height
Follow through full, son, perfect flight

[Verse 2]
Drop kick the ball bounces first, then strike
Used at restarts and field goals alike
Grubber kick low along the ground bouncing
Perfect for behind the defensive line trouncing

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the kick is a release valve
When the line is set and the space is calve
Kick to compete, son, kick to space
Make the chase, win the ball back race

[Chorus]
Kick the punt and the drop, son
Foot connects with the laces, the work begun
Spiral for distance, end over end for height
Follow through full, son, perfect flight

[Outro]
Punt for distance, drop for goal
Grubber for the chase, son, three of the soul
Laces on laces, follow through full
Thats my boy, thats the rule
